decisive_items: Substantial mass in left lung with pleural invasion, showing irregular mass with lobulation, spiculation, and pleural invasion
Long T1 and T2 signals with severe edema, circular enhancement on contrast-enhanced T1 sequence
response.rationale: Fungal hyphae in the brain lesion with a lung mass and CNS imaging findings indicate disseminated invasive aspergillosis; lung cancer is contradicted by non-malignant lung biopsy and fungal pathology.

rejected.why: Only addresses pulmonary findings and ignores the brain fungal hyphae and CNS symptoms.
Lung biopsy shows inflammation and fibrin, not malignancy, and brain pathology shows fungal hyphae rather than metastatic cells.
Too nonspecific; fungal hyphae and lung involvement favor invasive aspergillosis over a generic brain abscess.
